items.question: How many digits does a Makani number have in Dubai's Makani smart addressing system?
items.gold: Each building is assigned a unique 10-digit Makani number.
items.fact: Makani assigns each building a unique 10-digit number

items.question: Does the RTA Smart Drive app require a mobile Internet connection to operate?
items.gold: No, Smart Drive operates without a mobile Internet connection.
items.fact: Smart Drive app works without mobile Internet connection
